description: Lucet was formed from the merger of Tridiuum and New Directions Behavioral Health, combining Tridiuum's assessment technology with New Directions' managed care expertise. The platform administers validated behavioral health assessments and generates a proprietary Behavioral Health Index (BHI) score that quantifies symptom severity across dimensions. This score helps guide treatment planning, level of care decisions, and ongoing progress monitoring. With over 1.5 million patients and 6 million assessments completed, Lucet serves health plans, employers, and healthcare organizations.

faqs.q: What is the Behavioral Health Index (BHI)?
faqs.a: The BHI is Lucet's proprietary scoring algorithm that quantifies behavioral health symptom severity across multiple dimensions. It's used to match patients to appropriate levels of care and track treatment progress over time.

Tridiuum merged with New Directions Behavioral Health to form Lucet. The combined company offers both assessment technology (from Tridiuum) and managed behavioral health services (from New Directions).

faqs.q: Is Lucet suitable for private practices?
faqs.a: Lucet primarily serves health plans, employers, and large behavioral health organizations. For private practices wanting outcome tracking, consider Blueprint (free) or Owl Practice instead.

faqs.q: How does Lucet compare to Blueprint?
faqs.a: Blueprint is designed for individual clinicians with a free EHR and pay-per-use AI. Lucet is an enterprise platform for health plans and large organizations, focusing on population-level assessment and BHI scoring for level-of-care decisions.
